card.name: The word systemic in drug labels
card.fires_on: The word "systemic", either the ending "ic" after "System" or the whole word " systemic". It appears in drug label text such as systemic corticosteroids, systemic mastocytosis, systemic symptoms and systemic manifestations.

modes.label: Ending of System-ic
modes.description: The "ic" that completes "System" at the start of a sentence or heading, before corticosteroids or a disease name.
modes.example: administration of SOHONOS with tetracycline derivatives [see Adverse Reactions (6.1) ] . 7.4 System<<ic>> Corticosteroids No clinically significant drug

modes.label: Whole word systemic
modes.description: The full word " systemic" before a disease name or "manifestations".
modes.example: Adult patients with previously untreated<< systemic>> ALCL or other CD30-ex

card.plain: It lights up on the word "systemic" in label text, as in systemic steroids or whole-body symptoms.
